text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ever since I became Sasami Anshinzawa's 
acupuncture test dummy, I've grown
accustomed to playing along with her
whims. On one such
day...

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Hey, <username>!
Look at
what I've got!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I won this ticket for a hot spring
vacation from a
raffle! This must be some kind of
reward for my
usual good deeds! ♪

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Gosh, what's with that lukewarm
response? You're
coming along as well,
you know?
choice_data_list: Good karma at work... Er, I mean, ...

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
The ticket's for two, and who better to
invite
along than my trusty partner?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Now enough talking. Off to the hot
spring we
go! ♪

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Wow! ☆ What a luxurious inn! ♪ I'm
definitely
gonna brag about this to my
master after I get
back!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Consider it thanks for always

cooperating with my acupuncture
practice! ♪
choice_data_list: Were you really okay with that?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, but don't start thinking that I
settled for you because I had nobody
else to invite. I'm not some
loner without
friends, you hear me?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Mmm! ♪

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh... That felt fantastic! ♪ There's
nothing
more relaxing than a soak in a
hot spring! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After a soothing bath, I happen to bump
into
Sasami Anshinzawa in the corridor.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Oh! Did you just finish bathing as well?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Hot springs sure are amazing! Their
restorative
properties are on par with
those of
acupuncture! ♪

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, do you want to go explore the
souvenir shop
with me? You should get
something for your
trainee there!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, acupuncture has a big
history in the local area, so we somehow
end up buying
matching needle
keychains...

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Sigh... I'm in heaven! What would I give to just kick back and relax here for eternity! ♪

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I do... I still have an important
duty to
fulfill, after all!
choice_data_list: We really can't do that, though.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I'm duty bound to help Umamusume with
my
needles and relieve them of their
worries!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to your assistance, I'm a much
better
acupuncturist than before! And
I'm going to keep
on honing my skills! ♪

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Yep! With you as my partner, I know I
can make it
big in the acupuncture
world!
choice_data_list: Let's keep this up and raise our s...

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Hey, I know! If we're going to do this,
why don't
we expand overseas?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
We can share the wonders of
acupuncture with people all over the
world! My little sister's well-informed
about global affairs, so I'm sure she'd be
happy to lend a hand! ♪

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
But wait, there's more! When the time
comes—

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
choice_data_list: ...I'm sorry, but I have to be the...
...I'm sorry, but I have to be the...

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you! Did you think I was serious?! I
was only
pulling your leg! ♪

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I have no intention of getting in between
you and
your racer! None at all!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
However, my gratitude for you comes
from the heart! ♪ Master even said I can
move on from fetching drin—ahem, that
I'm allowed to proceed to the next step
of my training!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
With me on poking duty and you as my
backup,
we're sure to be on the
steadiest road to
success! ☆

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, nothing beats an acupuncture
session
after a nice relaxing soak! ♪

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I prepared some special needles for
today! Come
on, get ready to get a few
pokes in you! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I already had my suspicions, so I'm not
surprised
things turned out this way...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But then again, this is just par for the
course when
it comes to the two of us.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Hold still... Annnd poke!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Puncture Perfect!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Well? Am I amazing or what? I practiced
my butt
off for today! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thud!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Oh my! The treatment was successful, so
what's
going on?!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Was it too effective? Hellooo? Can you hear me?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Dang it! I'll get it perfectly right next
time!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to look after you so well,
you'll
regret
ever refusing my offer! ☆

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
So you'd better have
<chrname>'s
back and
support her as best you can, m'kay?!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
You sense that you and Sasami
Anshinzawa have formed an
irreplaceable bond during this time

together.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite my consciousness slipping
further and further away, my indignance
still slips through in
one final mental
outburst.
